pages.title: Like / Toss / Favorite
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Like$(): redstone + paper$(li)$(item)Coin Toss$(): emerald + iron ingot$(li)$(item)Favorite$(): book and quill + ender pearl$(br2)Each part can be disabled in the config; disabled parts drop their recipe.

pages.title: What they do
pages.text: $(li)$(item)Like$(): Goad (8s) to yourself and players within 8 blocks, hearts, 20s cooldown$(li)$(item)Coin Toss$(): 50/50 Luck or Bad Luck for 60s, 2s cooldown, no item consumed$(li)$(item)Favorite$(): bookmark blocks, sneak + right click to list (max 16)

pages.title: Luck & Bad Luck
pages.text: Luck / Bad Luck add +1 / -1 to the luck attribute. It affects chests and barrels, mob drops, fishing, archaeology brushing, trial vaults and advancement rewards (higher weight for quality entries, extra loot rolls).$(br2)It does NOT affect enchanting, anvils or villager trades. Having both cancels out.
